snippet.title: Hundred Days - Winemaking Simulator - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hundred Days will put you in charge of managing a small and abandoned winery: from selecting the types of vine you want to grow, to naming your final product, every decision of the challenging business of winemaking will be in your hands. 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042380/Hundred_Days__Winemaking_Simulator/

Epic Games Store: https://www.epicgames.com/store/en-US/p/hundred-days-winemaking-simulator

Google Stadia: https://stadia.com/link/FRNsjdSyfjyaLimC6
